title: A Garden for the Sigil
author: Wendell Eriksen
blurb: Mirabel Ravensworth, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
